hero.title: Your staff already know things these students cannot find out
hero.body: List employees as mentors, cover a school talk, or fund a term of them. It meets a CSR objective without a workshop, a lanyard or a report nobody reads, and it is felt by an actual fifteen-year-old.

cta.title: Worth a conversation?
cta.body: Tell us roughly what you have in mind. A few willing staff, one sponsored talk, or something ongoing. We will work out what fits and we will not send you a deck.
